03908398c7d421a0.description:
We're looking for an experienced Agile Program Manager to lead delivery across multiple cross-functional teams working toward a shared set of business outcomes. You'll sit at the intersection of strategy and execution: translating roadmap priorities into coordinated, predictable delivery, keeping dependencies visible, and making sure the right people are making the right decisions at the right time.
This is a hands-on program role, not a status-reporting one. You'll own the cadence, the plan, and the risks across several Agile teams, and you'll be the person stakeholders trust to tell them where things really stand.
What You'll Do
• Lead end-to-end delivery of a multi-team program, coordinating three or more Agile teams (Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid) toward shared quarterly objectives.
• Run program-level planning, including quarterly/PI planning, roadmap alignment, capacity planning, and release planning.
• Identify, map, and actively manage cross-team dependencies, risks, and blockers, escalating early and with clear options.
• Facilitate program ceremonies such as Scrum of Scrums, program syncs, system demos, and retrospectives, and make sure they produce decisions, not just updates.
• Partner with Product Owners and Product Managers to keep backlogs prioritized, refined, and aligned to business value.
• Build and maintain program-level reporting: delivery health, burn-up/velocity trends, OKR or objective progress, and RAID logs, tailored for both team-level and executive audiences.
• Drive continuous improvement in delivery practices, tooling, and team workflows, coaching teams and leaders on Agile principles where needed.
• Manage stakeholder communication across engineering, product, design, business, and leadership, keeping expectations aligned as scope and priorities shift.
• Track program budget, resourcing, and vendor or third-party deliverables where applicable.
What You Bring
• 8+ years of experience in program or project management, with at least 5 years leading delivery in Agile environments.
• Proven track record managing multi-team programs (not just single-team Scrum) from planning through release.
• Deep, practical knowledge of Scrum and Kanban, plus experience with at least one scaling framework (SAFe, LeSS, Scrum@Scale, or similar).
• Strong command of Agile tooling such as Jira, Jira Align, Azure DevOps, Rally, or equivalent, including building dashboards and program-level reporting.
• Excellent facilitation skills: you can run a 50-person planning event as comfortably as a tense 1:1 escalation.
• Clear, concise written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to tailor the message for engineers and executives alike.
• Experience working with distributed or remote teams across time zones.
• Comfort operating with ambiguity: you can stand up structure where there is none and adapt it as the program evolves.
Nice to Have
• Agile or program management certifications such as SAFe RTE, SAFe SPC, PMI-ACP, PgMP, PMP, CSM/CSP, or ICAgile.
• Experience with Agile transformations or introducing scaled frameworks into an organization.
• Background in software, SaaS, data, or digital product delivery.
• Familiarity with OKRs and value-stream or portfolio management.
• Experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, insurance, public sector) where Agile delivery coexists with compliance requirements.
• Budget and vendor management experience on programs with multiple delivery partners.

Product Management Intern – Identity Resilience

About the Team & Role

The Product Management team at Rubrik drives forward our vision of delivering a market-leading platform that addresses the world’s most critical cyber resilience and data security challenges.

The Identity Resilience team is Rubrik’s fastest-growing business unit, operating with a high-velocity "0-to-1" charter. Today, modern cyberattacks almost exclusively weaponize identity systems. When identity fails, the entire enterprise halts. Our mission is to ensure enterprise identity environments are secure, observable, compliant, and instantly recoverable.

We are looking for a strategically sharp, technical, and execution-minded Product Management Intern for a high-impact 2-month internship based in Bengaluru. As an intern, you will own a core strategic initiative – bridging enterprise customer pain points, competitive differentiation, and technical architecture to deliver a concrete product roadmap for next-generation identity protection.

What You’ll Do (2-Month Charter)

  • Market Landscape & Threat Vector Analysis: Benchmark the enterprise identity attack surface across hybrid environments. Map emerging threat vectors to potential resilience and recovery capabilities.
  • Customer Discovery & Pain Point Synthesis: Work alongside PM and GTM mentors to analyze customer requirements, telemetry data, and enterprise security frameworks to pinpoint the highest-friction operational gaps for Security and IAM teams.
  • Feature Strategy & PRD Ownership: Define the scope, user workflows, and success metrics for a targeted identity protection/recovery feature. Author a high-quality Product Requirement Document (PRD) balancing enterprise-grade depth with Rubrik’s trademark simplicity.
  • Cross-Functional Architecture Alignment: Collaborate closely with Engineering, UX Design, and Architecture leads to evaluate technical trade-offs, define API/data pipeline requirements, and ensure feasibility.
  • Executive Strategy Pitch: Conclude your internship with an Executive Product Readout to Senior Leadership, defending your business case, technical trade-offs, and proposed roadmap.

What You’ll Need

  • Education: Currently enrolled in a premier MBA/management program (IIM, ISB, or equivalent global top-tier business school) graduating in 2027/28
  • Technical Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or an equivalent engineering discipline. Prior product management or technical experience in enterprise systems, cloud platforms, or cybersecurity is a strong plus.
  • Systems & Security Thinking: An understanding of enterprise software fundamentals; familiarity with core identity concepts is an advantage.
  • Problem Solving: Comfort with ambiguity, structured thinking, and the ability to break complex, undefined problems into crisp, actionable requirements.
  • Communication & Influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate technical trade-offs to senior product and engineering leaders.
  • Location: Based in or willing to relocate to Bengaluru for the 2-month internship duration (Hybrid model).

What You’ll Gain

  • True 0-to-1 Problem Ownership: Direct ownership of a real-world, high-priority product problem in enterprise cybersecurity – not a back-burner sandbox project.
  • High-Stakes Leadership Visibility: Regular 1:1 mentorship from seasoned Product Managers and a final presentation to Product & Engineering leadership.
  • Cybersecurity PM Expertise: Hands-on exposure to cutting-edge identity governance, threat modeling, and resilience frameworks inside an enterprise security market leader.

The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.

Company Overview

Capwise Financial Services is a full-service investment banking and financial advisory firm that helps businesses raise capital, execute strategic transactions, and navigate complex financial decisions across domestic and cross-border markets. With experience spanning 200+ debt transactions and 35+ equity and M&A deals, the firm combines a strong origination network with an active deal pipeline and a partner-led model, where sector heads own their client franchise, revenue budgets, and teams, supported by Capwise’s broader platform, central origination network, and execution capabilities.

 Position Overview
 
We are seeking an experienced Investment Banking professional for our Consumer vertical. Unlike many investment banking roles, this position is primarily focused on transaction execution rather than cold origination. The firm will support deal sourcing and introductions.
Your role begins once a prospect is identified or a warm introduction is made. You will present the firm's execution capabilities, finalize mandate documents, and lead the end-to-end execution of fund-raising (equity/debt) and Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) transactions.

 Key Responsibilities

1. Mandate Closure & Onboarding
• Pitch to Win: Partner with the origination team during initial introductions to present deep sectoral knowledge and bespoke execution strategies that convert prospects into clients.
• Mandate Structuring: Draft, negotiate, and finalize Mandate Letters, Engagement Agreements, and fee structures, ensuring the commercial interests of the firm are protected.

2. End-to-End Deal Execution
• Transaction Management: Lead and oversee the entire lifecycle of capital raising (PE, IPO, Structured Finance) and M&A (buy-side, sell-side, joint ventures) transactions.
• Financial Modeling & Valuation: Supervise the creation of complex financial models, valuation analyses (DCF, comparable companies, precedent transactions), and investment thesis formulations.
• Collateral Preparation: Ensure the highest quality production of pitch books, Confidential Information Memorandums (CIMs), Teasers, and Management Presentations.

3. Due Diligence & Deal Closing
• Data Room Management: Setup and oversee Virtual Data Rooms (VDR), managing the flow of information between clients, investors, and buyers.
• Due Diligence Coordination: Lead the financial, legal, tax, and commercial due diligence processes, actively resolving deal-breakers and bottlenecks.
• Definitive Documentation: Collaborate with legal counsels to negotiate and finalize Share Purchase Agreements (SPA), Share Subscription Agreements (SSA), Shareholders' Agreements (SHA), and other definitive transaction documents.

4. Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management
• Pod Leadership: Manage, mentor, and maximize the productivity of a dedicated team of AVPs, Associates, and Analysts within your vertical.
• Client Management: Act as the primary, trusted point of contact for C-suite executives and promoters throughout the execution cycle, managing expectations and maintaining momentum.

 Qualifications & Experience

• Education: MBA from a Tier-1 business school, Chartered Accountant (CA), or CFA.
• Experience: 9 to 12+ years of core investment banking experience within a reputed IB firm, institutional platform, or boutique advisory house.
• Track Record: A proven history of independently closing mid-to-large cap M&A and fundraising transactions. Must be able to demonstrate an extensive list of closed deals where you acted as a primary execution lead.
• Sector Expertise: Deep domain knowledge, regulatory understanding, and active investor networks within the Consumer vertical.
• Skills: Strong negotiation skills, sound understanding of legal documentation/deal structures, and sharp analytical acumen.

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Software Engineer II

Who is Mastercard?

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.

Overview

The Mastercard Payment Networks team is looking for a Software Development Engineer to drive our customer experience strategy forward by consistently innovating and problem-solving. The ideal candidate is passionate about the customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain high-quality, scalable applications with a strong focus on design, code quality, and maintainability.
• Build backend services using Java (17+), applying core Object-Oriented principles, SOLID practices, and standard design patterns.
• Contribute to development of microservices-based applications using frameworks such as Spring Boot and foundational event-driven concepts.
• Translate well-defined requirements into efficient and reliable technical implementations.
• Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth integration and successful delivery.
• Develop and deploy solutions in a CI/CD-enabled environment (e.g., PCF or similar cloud platforms).
• Implement appropriate data persistence solutions (RDBMS, NoSQL such as Cassandra) based on application needs.
• Follow coding standards, quality practices, and program guidelines to ensure clean and reliable code.
• Participate in Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and technology evaluations with guidance from senior engineers.
• Identify issues during development and testing phases, and contribute to timely resolution.
• Communicate progress, challenges, and technical details effectively within the team.
• Actively participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to team commitments.
• Collaborate closely with peers and demonstrate strong teamwork and ownership.
• Support and mentor junior developers when required, while also driving continuous self-learning.
• Stay updated with emerging technologies and development practices.

All About You

• Strong foundation in Full Stack or Backend development with a passion for building quality software.
• Good understanding of Java, Spring Boot, and modern application development practices.
• Exposure to event-driven architecture and distributed systems concepts is an advantage.
• Experience working on online / real-time systems.
• Familiarity with CI/CD practices and tools.
• Working knowledge of database technologies including RDBMS and NoSQL (e.g., Cassandra).
• Exposure to cloud platforms (e.g., PCF or similar) and digital-native architectures is desirable.
• Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to learn quickly and adapt.
• Effective communication and collaboration skills.
• Basic mentoring capability and willingness to support team growth.

Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

• Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
• Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
• Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
• Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

We're looking for a Project Manager to own the day-to-day delivery of a large-scale localization program for a multinational gaming publisher. Support vendor management, including onboarding and evaluating linguists and other specialist vendors for the account.

Proven experience as a project manager in the localization industry, with direct experience delivering programs for a game publisher or games customer.

Hands-on experience managing transcreation, subtitling, DTP, video rendering/editing and linguistic/mechanical QC workflows concurrently across multiple languages.

Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple concurrent, deadline-driven workstreams.
• 
Clear, confident written and verbal communication in English.
Nice to Have

Experience with additional localization or workflow platforms beyond those listed above.
• 
Familiarity with quality frameworks such as ISO 17100 or ISO 9001.
• 
Experience working with global, multi-time-zone teams.

The opportunity to work on high-profile, high-visibility programs for a global brand.

Exposure to cutting-edge AI-powered localization technology.

03bc846a2829505b.description: Overview: Role Summary This role partners directly with US-based Corporate and Business Unit Finance teams to support consolidated reporting, budgeting and forecasting for RealPage globally, and to help build a best-in-class business analytics capability within India Shared Services and Corporate Functions. RealPage is a subscription software business with an embedded payments and services layer, serving the real estate and property management industry. The financials behave accordingly - recurring revenue, deferred revenue, site and unit-driven billing, and transaction volume, and the analysis is expected to reflect that. We are looking for someone who does more than produce the pack. You will be expected to shorten the distance between data and decisions, automating what repeats, using AI tools to accelerate analysis and drafting, and spending the time you save on judgement: explaining what moved, why it moved, and what leadership should do about it. Responsibilities: Primary Responsibilities Reporting, Analytics & Commentary - Prepare monthly financial metrics and KPIs specific to assigned products, segments, or functional groups. - Own P&L and headcount reporting, analytics and commentary, delivering per published deadlines. - Produce monthly variance reporting, Risks & Opportunities, and Flash reporting (pre-month-end expense estimates). - Refresh and analyze billing logs, site activations, licenses, and revenue reconciliations. - Identify, investigate, and explain key movements and trends across P&L lines and their components. - Build executive dashboards and variance-walk content that a senior audience can act on without further explanation. - Create ad hoc analysis on large datasets and draw defensible inferences, including sizing the impact and stating the confidence level of the conclusion. - Report and interpret SaaS operating metrics for the assigned products or segments, ARR and ARR movement, net and gross revenue retention, churn, bookings-to-billings-to-revenue conversion, and unit economics and explain what they mean for the business, not only what they are. Planning: Budget & Forecast - Support monthly forecasts and the annual financial plan alongside US Finance partners, including analysis explaining changes against prior forecasts, plan and prior year. - Model variance drivers for headcount, operating expense and revenue (billings) as required. - Build and challenge revenue drivers on a subscription basis, units or sites, price, activations, attrition and expansion, rather than forecasting revenue as a single growth rate. - Develop Risks & Opportunities under multiple scenarios and identify actions to bridge gaps to target. - Help set and continuously improve the budget and forecast operating rhythm, managing stakeholders across geographies. Month-End Close - Drive assigned close activities in coordination with GL Accounting, AP, and other teams. - Review accrual and reclass journal entries prior to posting. - Track and review financials daily through the close window, comparing actuals to plan, forecast and prior period, and investigating unusual postings. - Review vendor, purchase order, and invoice detail to support spend management and accrual identification. - Provide a consolidated workday-by-workday view of impact to P&L and SG&A through preliminary and final close. AI-Enabled Analysis, Automation & Process Improvement - Apply approved AI and automation tools to the recurring FP&A workload, first-draft variance commentary, reconciliation explainers, data cleansing, document summarization and report assembly and reinvest the time saved in analysis and business partnering. - Review and validate every AI-generated output before it is used. You remain accountable for the numbers, the sources and the narrative; unverified AI output is not an acceptable deliverable. - Identify manual, repetitive or error-prone processes and propose the fix: automation, template redesign, tool change or process elimination. Bring a business case, not just an observation. - Participate in and support Finance Transformation initiatives; share working automations, prompts and techniques with the wider team rather than keeping them local. Business Partnering - Collaborate with senior team members and business line CFOs on recurring and ad hoc requests, including monthly reviews, Board decks, monthly forecast reviews and headcount approvals. - Engage US partners directly, surface process pain points, initiate improvement projects, allocate the right resources and report project status. - Work as part of a distributed team across the region, with regular exposure to regional and global Finance leadership. Qualifications: Qualifications Education & Experience - Bachelors degree in finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field required. MBA (Finance), CA or ICWA is an added advantage. - Senior Analyst: 69 years of relevant experience, with at least 4 years of experience in FP&A. - Experience supporting a .
